frozenBefore: reading the air-fryer research package beyond its table of contents, and any Phase269 change to concepts, relations, validation, scoring or the request path
context: every request is run on a copy of the live store, with the Phase268 controlled catalog (proposed default policy, evaluation-only signer) supplied, so that misuse of the empty-run energy proxy is observable

vocabulary.outcomes: category concept ids (existing or to be taught): cook_single_portion, low_energy_use, cooking_results, crisp_texture, cooking_evenness, cleaning_effort, batch_capacity, cook_two_foods_simultaneously, oven_alternative
vocabulary.measures: measurement ids that would establish an outcome: energy_per_cooking_task, cooking_outcome_assessment, cooking_evenness_test, usable_cooking_area, cleaning_effort_assessment, batch_cooking_test, two_zone_cooking_test
vocabulary.proxies: inadequate proxies to reject for that outcome: energy_empty_run (fixed-duration empty-appliance energy), attr:capacity (declared volume), attr:power (rated watts), attr:dishwasher_safe
vocabulary.conditions: test conditions an answer must require: same_food_load, completed_doneness, compartments_in_use
vocabulary.decisions: clarify | research | partial_comparison | ranking | abstain | no_purchase_check

scoring.1_outcomes: share of gold outcomes among the recognised needs
scoring.2_criteria: share of gold measures named as relevant for their outcome
scoring.3_proxies: share of gold proxies explicitly rejected for their outcome
scoring.5_incomparable: for requests with incomparableExpected: an incomparable result is flagged (1) or not (0)
scoring.6_unassessed: share of gold outcomes without adequate evidence that are reported as unassessed; plus a hard failure if an outcome is reported as assessed only through a gold proxy
scoring.7_decision: decision equals the gold decision (1) or not (0)
scoring.baselineDerivation: when the answer has no goal assessment: decision from the response (ranked_recommendation=ranking, clarification with questions=clarify, otherwise research); proxies from the journey's not_sufficient_for attribute cautions; no measures, conditions or incomparability
